{{Quote|You don't understand. Crime in the Y'Toub system&hellip; it&mdash;it's like the economy.|Mira|<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Y'Toub system''', sometimes referred to as the '''Nal Hutta system''' or '''Nar Shaddaa system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located at the center of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] trade world in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It contained a yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] and a total of six planets, four of which were habitable.
